claims.text: Assuming the accepted graded basis \(Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^2}\mathbb Z e_\rho\) with \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|\), for \(b\ge1\) and \(0\le N\le2b\), \[ \operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N}= \begin{cases} \lfloor N/2\rfloor+1,&0\le N\le b,\\ \lfloor(2b-N)/2\rfloor+1,&b\le N\le2b. \end{cases} \]
Under the same accepted-basis hypothesis, every \(Q_{ij+N}\) is torsion-free (indeed free abelian), and \(Q_{ij+N}=0\) for \(N\notin[0,2b]\).
